record.paper_title: Billiard dynamics: A survey with the emphasis on open problems
record.context_brief: Exponential growth rate of periodic orbits
record.original_question: For a dispersing billiard table Y, let f_Y(n) denote the number of periodic orbits of period at most n. Does the limit h = lim_{n→∞} (log f_Y(n))/n exist?

evidence.quote: Задача 5. Существует ли следующий предел? h = limn→∞ log fY (n) / n

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $Y$ be a dispersing (Sinai) billiard table: a compact domain in the plane (or on the two-dimensional torus) whose boundary consists of finitely many smooth curves, each strictly convex when viewed from inside $Y$, so that the associated billiard flow (free motion inside $Y$ with elastic reflection at the boundary) is uniformly hyperbolic. For a positive integer $n$, let $f_Y(n)$ denote the number of periodic orbits of the billiard flow in $Y$ of period at most $n$.

Does the limit
$$h \;=\; \lim_{n\to\infty} \frac{\log f_Y(n)}{n}$$
exist (as a finite real number)?
artifact.status_search_result: For dispersing/semi-dispersing billiards, Stojanov, Burago–Ferleger–Kononenko, and others established that the number of periodic orbits of period at most n grows at most exponentially, and matching exponential lower bounds are known in many cases, so $\limsup$ and $\liminf$ are both finite and positive. However, the existence of the actual limit (equivalently, that the exponential growth rate is well-defined as a limit, not merely as $\limsup$) does not appear to be established in the literature; the question is generally regarded as open.

status_evidence.title: An estimate from above of the number of periodic orbits for semi-dispersed billiards
status_evidence.snippet: Stojanov's exponential upper bound on the number of periodic orbits for semi-dispersed billiards.
status_evidence.claim: Exponential upper bound on f_Y(n) is known, but existence of the limit is not asserted.

status_evidence.title: Topological Entropy and Pressure for Finite Horizon Sinai Billiards (Demers, ICM 2022)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses topological entropy and exponential growth bounds for periodic orbits in Sinai billiards.
status_evidence.claim: Bounds on growth are known; existence of the limit of (log f_Y(n))/n is not stated as a theorem.

status_evidence.title: Topological entropy and periodic points of two-dimensional hyperbolic billiards
status_evidence.snippet: Relates topological entropy to growth of periodic points in hyperbolic billiards.
status_evidence.claim: Provides exponential bounds tied to topological entropy but does not establish the limit's existence in full generality.
